scope: Mechanic groups, all 25 original UI mappings, six tutorial mappings, 13 levels and 19 goals. Supplements the existing full 3,454-row source catalogue.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Provider business and home market
mechanics.player_action: Pick a name, market and difficulty. Start with finite capital and a team.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Home market affects available supply and customers; it is not a legal approval.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Customer site or provider service hub
mechanics.player_action: Build an owned deployment in a market and connect eligible customer sites.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Keep tenant, customer, site and shared provider hub distinct.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: UC/CC platform, gateway and media capacity
mechanics.player_action: Choose a platform or appliance tier with typed capacity, dependencies and cost.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Transport bandwidth, voice sessions, named seats and agents remain different.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Carrier, PSTN and wholesale communications supply
mechanics.player_action: Buy calling reach, numbering and concurrent sessions with recurring and usage charges.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: A carrier connection does not automatically supply a CC workforce.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Supported federation, interoperability and shared connectivity
mechanics.player_action: Pay for a supported connection that broadens eligible counterparties or lowers a declared cost.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Do not imply that UC federation works like universal free internet peering.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Direct routing, SBC or dedicated interconnect/integration
mechanics.player_action: Purchase a compatible dedicated path with limits, lead time and ongoing operating work.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Protocol/media/authority requirements are explicit; a drawn line grants nothing.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Site connectivity, carrier paths and deployment projects
mechanics.player_action: Drag or select two eligible endpoints, compare options, commit a funded delivery job.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Retain literal transport where it affects UC; integration links are a separate edge type.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Retained underlay and typed session/media upgrades
mechanics.player_action: Increase only the constrained unit and respect compatible equipment and delivery.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Never translate every Gbit/s into a seat count.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Local media, local information processing or reusable work
mechanics.player_action: Choose a local capability that reduces a specific dependency, transit load or repeated effort.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Mapping is conditional: each source cache obligation needs a causal counterpart, not a forced noun swap.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Recurring managed UC users and small-business contracts
mechanics.player_action: Launch a managed service; grow or lose eligible demand based on fit, experience and price.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Opening customers have authored requirements and activation conditions.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: UC, CC, video and managed-service opportunities
mechanics.player_action: Compare an expiring brief, promise outcomes, quote within market rules and deliver.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Accepted offer, deployed capacity, service delivery and earned revenue are separate.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Customer jobs, session occupancy, queues and backlogs
mechanics.player_action: Observe calls, messages, meetings and processing consume the relevant resources.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: One customer case can cross channels; avoid double-counting resolution.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Reachable people, numbers, tenants, channels and supported joins
mechanics.player_action: Extend real service eligibility through numbering, federation and compatibility.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: A global health score cannot replace a specific reachability or policy failure.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Experience, contract confidence and renewal
mechanics.player_action: Queue wait, quality, delivery, context and obligations affect demand and renewal.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Use period history and segment needs, not a final readiness flag.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Service incidents and funded recovery
mechanics.player_action: Assess affected journeys, buy a workaround, allocate engineers or use resilience.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Incident scheduling belongs to the scenario. Repair completes only after work.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Synthetic abuse, admission, fraud and resilience choices
mechanics.player_action: Invest in bounded protection and handle synthetic incidents with measurable service effects.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Retain distinctions between capacity attack, account abuse and media failure.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Provider treasury, credit and lease/buy decisions
mechanics.player_action: Balance growth, recurring commitments, reserves and cash-flow risk.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Loan proceeds are financing, not operating profit.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Provider margin, cash, commitments and delivered workload
mechanics.player_action: Expose understandable costs and earned revenue while the service runs.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Use fictional cents and declared /period units; separate diagnostic totals.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Commercial capabilities and meaningful expansion
mechanics.player_action: Unlock customer segments, partner terms, service types and useful automation.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: A badge without a new choice is supplementary, not sufficient progression.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Partner offers, qualification, integration and training opportunities
mechanics.player_action: Choose limited-time terms or invest scarce staff in a relationship/capability.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Give every event a cost or opportunity tradeoff; no mandatory networking busywork.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Provisioning, assurance and lifecycle automation
mechanics.player_action: Automate mastered bulk work subject to scope, budget and capacity.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Automation changes work economics; it does not bypass authority or guarantee outcomes.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Bundles, vendor-direct offers, channel shifts and lifecycle changes
mechanics.player_action: Alter eligible opportunities and terms, then let the player adapt their proposition.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: A small authored market is enough; every actor need not be an autonomous AI corporation.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Segment missions and seeded contract challenges
mechanics.player_action: Offer meaningful variations in demand, supplier access, budget and failure exposure.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Declare scenario fiction and do not turn jurisdiction labels into certification.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Shared provider clock
mechanics.player_action: Pause, compare choices, resume and accelerate work through one deterministic scheduler.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Frame rate, visual particles and hidden-tab time do not change business rules.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Customer/service inspector and interaction replay
mechanics.player_action: Select a real node/path, understand impact, then take a relevant costed action.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Raw evidence remains available as a diagnostic drilldown.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Migration, retirement and service-policy planning
mechanics.player_action: Preview affected customers, obligations and costs before a staged change.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Keep active work, authority, data retention and rollback conditions explicit.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Fictional UC/CC suppliers, partners, customers and competitors
mechanics.player_action: Preserve original personality while tying each visible actor to supply, demand or a distinctive event.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Keep all source IDs. Similar economics may share code; source-specific behaviour remains separately evidenced.

mechanics.uc_cc_replacement: Workforce, journeys, CPaaS, information and boundary systems
mechanics.player_action: Integrate new mechanics into procurement, capacity, service and renewal decisions.
mechanics.fidelity_rule: Do not present the 94 additions as 94 compulsory setup tasks.

ui.upstream_label: Company, cash, traffic, reach, tier, customers, incidents
ui.existing_uc_mapping: Service outcomes, margin, resource pressure and incidents
ui.required_purpose: Cash available, forecast /period, active customers, due-job completion, capacity warning, period and speed.
One active objective, next unlock and evidence of progress.

ui.existing_uc_mapping: Sales opportunities, tenders and partner events
ui.required_purpose: Expiring customer briefs, tenders, partner and training offers.
Prioritised customer impact and actionable costed responses.
Relationships, supply, supported integrations and actionable requests.
Customer needs, workloads, outcomes and contracts in the selected scope.
Calling, platforms, carrier choices and capacity offers.
Compatible federation, integrations and interconnect choices.
Typed transport/application dependencies and affected journeys.

ui.existing_uc_mapping: Gateways, media, rooms, local processing and power
ui.required_purpose: Gateways, local media, rooms, power and processors with costed upgrades.
Earned revenue, cash, liabilities, outcomes and bottlenecks.
Portfolio obligations, renewal risk and customer-level economics.
Integration scope, support ownership, compatibility and health.

ui.existing_uc_mapping: Usage by customer job, channel, provider and cost
ui.required_purpose: Demand, completions, waits and use by customer, channel and unit.
Actual and reserved transport, sessions, staff, rooms and processing.
Leased/owned resources, minimum terms, cancellation and renewal exposure.
Credit, covenants, reserves, repayment and insolvency choices.

ui.upstream_label: Title, home city, mode and scenario picker
ui.existing_uc_mapping: Company, home region and campaign picker
ui.required_purpose: Continue, Play, scenarios; secondary Training, Lab and retained SP mode.
Short explanations linked to the selected decision and optional deeper reference.
Short consequence messages with links to the affected customer/service.

ui.upstream_label: Link load, egress and cost detail
ui.required_purpose: Load, supported features, costs, dependencies and current failure.

ui.existing_uc_mapping: Tenant, platform and site retirement planner
ui.required_purpose: Impact preview, prerequisites, retained obligations and staged work.
Recipes first; optional expert editor and dry-run impact comparison.
Readable customer timeline followed by advanced protocol/evidence details.

ui.upstream_label: Customer alerts, sound, animation and language
ui.existing_uc_mapping: Equivalent preferences with service-outcome alert thresholds
ui.required_purpose: Language, sound, reduced motion, alerts, input help, save/export and view preferences.

progression_levels.proposed_commercial_unlock: Starter UC and basic CC are available on entry. A useful first service and renewal open further SMB prospects.
Shared-team portfolios, reusable provisioning templates and distributor offers.
Advanced queues, CRM handoff, room interoperability and enterprise bids.
Larger staged migrations, coexistence and repeatable migration runbooks.
Wholesale carrier coverage, number/capacity commitments and headroom decisions.
Government opportunities with workload-specific processing, records and support conditions.
Regional suppliers/distributors, language-matched support and multiple market obligations.
Advanced CPaaS, asynchronous handoffs, channel optimisation and BPO. Basic digital contact remains available earlier.
Dedicated, sovereign and customer-operated local architectures with distinct costs and dependencies.
Subpartner supply, scoped delegated operations and tenant billing responsibilities.
Evaluated speech/assistance, cloud/local processing, sustained processing load and quality/coaching choices.
Defence and disconnected continuity, local service dependencies and controlled reconciliation.
Preserve the canonical four-track fresh continuity, external billing and aggregate-profit endgame; do not silently replace it with an easier charter.

goals.proposed_commercial_predicate: First useful paid managed service with observed customer delivery.
Required external calling or channel reach used by actual work.
First supported integration used in a completed customer journey.
A multi-system journey retains context across its actual handoffs.
An additional funded site/customer connection becomes effective and useful.
A bespoke service contract activates and delivers its declared work.

goals.existing_name: The scenic route has a backup
goals.proposed_commercial_predicate: Sustain or recover service through a real incident under its cost and time constraints.
Local media or processing changes actual load, cost or allowed service locality.
A dedicated interconnection has a measurable service or economic purpose.
Contain synthetic abuse while preserving legitimate contracted work.
Operate service in three distinct markets with the relevant boundaries respected.
Earn a new synthetic supplier/wholesale relationship through operational evidence.

goals.existing_name: A thousand requests, and the hold music still works
goals.proposed_commercial_predicate: Sustain contracted workload scale in separate typed units, not renamed Gbit/s.
Commission a local/customer-operated deployment with its dependencies and operating cost.

goals.upstream_name: Be in two buildings at once
goals.proposed_commercial_predicate: Survive a site failure using genuinely independent supported paths.
Broaden regional service footprint while distinguishing market geography from jurisdiction.
Deliver a complex large-customer contract with measured obligations.

goals.existing_name: The giants can wait on hold
goals.proposed_commercial_predicate: Operate a larger sustainable portfolio with bounded staff and useful automation.
Meet the source-linked resilient/sustainable provider end condition; do not claim carrier-free telephony.
